data.name: 6hr Yacht Rental
data.headline: Make a day of it — drop anchor, party & enjoy the views
data.description:
Enjoy a scenic 6-hour private charter aboard BowTie, your luxury escape on the San Diego Bay. This experience is perfect for groups looking to relax, celebrate, or just soak in the views in style.

You’ll cruise past the iconic downtown skyline, glide under the Coronado Bridge,  and anchor up in Glorietta Bay for a laid-back lounging, swimming, and good vibes. Whether you’re sipping drinks on deck or capturing content with the skyline behind you, this ride is equal parts chill and unforgettable.

BYO food & drinks, or add a bartender, content package, or custom upgrades for a fully tailored experience.
data.what_is_included:
Private use of the 80-ft BowTie yacht for 3 hours
Capacity for up to 13 guests
Cruise past downtown San Diego for skyline views
Anchor stop at Glorietta Bay
Premium sound system with Bluetooth connection
Deck lounge seating, dance floor, bow sunpads & water access ladder
Bottled water
Onboard crew member for support and safety
